name: Star-Carved Stone
text: +2 Lore when you seal a rift. Each rift you seal gives 1 extra Trophy.
flavor: A grey stone with a five-pointed star cut deep into it. It is warm to the touch.

name: Lens of Clear Seeing
text: +2 Wits. Gain 1 extra Clue when you investigate.
flavor: Through it, every lie has a shadow.

name: Bronze Sickle of Ur
flavor: Four thousand years old and still sharp.

name: Obsidian Mirror
text: Once per round, lose 1 Sanity to add 3 dice to any test.
flavor: Your reflection moves a moment after you do.

boosts.text: Look into the mirror: lose 1 Sanity for +3 dice.

name: Unbroken Chalice
text: Action: discard it to recover 4 Health and 4 Sanity.
flavor: Whatever you pour into it comes out as clear water.

action.text: Drink from the chalice: recover 4 Health and 4 Sanity, then discard it.

name: Chart of the Wandering Stars
text: Your first two rail or sea steps each Travel are free.
flavor: It shows the stars as they will be, not as they are.

name: Idol of the Sleeping God
text: +2 Nerve against horror. When you gain it, lose 1 Sanity.
flavor: A squat green figure with its eyes shut. Do not wake it.

name: Ring of the Ninth Hour
text: Action: discard it to make Doom retreat by 2.
flavor: Turn the ring backward, and the clocks of the world turn with it.

action.text: Turn the ring: Doom retreats by 2, then discard it.
